title: Structure theory of finite solvable Lie conformal algebras
summary: We develop a structure theory of finite solvable Lie conformal algebras. It is proved that every such algebra admits a Cartan subalgebra, and any two Cartan subalgebras are conjugate by a finite product of exponentials of nilpotent zero modes of elements of the derived algebra. Applied to finite vertex algebras, this yields inner conjugacy of Cartan subalgebras, answering a question of D'Andrea and Marchei.
